d:
The Spurs defeated the Kings, 124-109 tonight in Sacramento. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 30 points along with 14 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Spurs, while Devin Vassell tallied 19 points, 5 three pointers and 2 rebounds in the game. Darius Acuff Jr. recorded 22 points, 8 assists and 3 rebounds. The Spurs improve their record to 7-2 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-8 for the season.
